question: If (a)/(b) = (b)/(c) = (c)/(d), then frac{{{b³} + {c³} + {d³}}}{{{a³} + {b³} + {c³}}} will be equal to:
solution:
Given:

(a)/(b) = (b)/(c) = (c)/(d)

Calculation:

Let (a)/(b) = (b)/(c) = (c)/(d) = k

Then, a = bk , b = ck , c = dk

c = b/k 

d = c/k = b/k2

Putting values of a, b, c, d in terms of b in frac{{{b³} + {c³} + {d³}}}{{{a³} + {b³} + {c³}}}

⇒ frac{{{b³} + {(b/k)³} + {(b/k²)³}}}{{{(bk)³} + {b³} + {(b/k)³}}}

⇒ frac{[{{k⁶b³} + {(k³b³)} + {(b³)}}]/k⁶}{{[{b³k⁶} + {b³k³} + {b³]/k³}}}

⇒ frac{b³[{{k⁶} + {k³} + {1}}]/k³}{{b³[{k⁶} + {k³} + {1]}}}

⇒ (1)/(k³) ----- (i)

Now, checking all the options,

d/c = 1/k

b/d = b/(b/k²) = k²

a/d = bk/(b/k²) = k³

d/a = 1/k³

Option 4 matches with (i)

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
